data.title: Data collected
data.body:
Without an account: everything stays in your browser, nothing is sent to a server.
With an account: your email address, your account ID (and, if you sign in with Google, the name and picture provided by Google) and the content of your profile (name, avatar, factions, quests, progress and history). The hosting providers also keep technical logs (IP address, sign-in time) for security purposes.
If you use the marketplace: your public nickname, the factions you publish, your likes and your reports.

purposes.title: Purposes and legal basis
purposes.body: This data is only used to authenticate you, sync your profile across your devices and, if you use it, run the marketplace. This processing is necessary for the service you request by creating an account (GDPR article 6.1.b). No advertising, no data selling, no analytics.

marketplace.title: Marketplace (public content)
marketplace.body: If you publish a faction to the marketplace, the following becomes public: its name, icon or image, colour, description, themes, the definition of its quests (titles, descriptions, frequencies, rewards) and your public nickname. Your email, level, XP, gems, completed quests and history are never published. Your likes and reports are not visible to other players; reports (and their reason) are read by the publisher for moderation, and a faction reported several times is hidden. You can unpublish a faction at any time; copies already installed by other players stay with them. This sharing relies on your voluntary act of publishing (GDPR article 6.1.b).

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.body: Apart from content published to the marketplace, only the publisher and its technical processors can access it: Supabase (authentication and database), Vercel (hosting) and Google (only if you choose Google sign-in). As these companies may process data outside the European Union, transfers are covered by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses or the Data Privacy Framework.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Your data is kept as long as your account exists. When you request deletion, the account and its profile are erased within 30 days. Technical logs are kept for a limited time by the hosting providers.

storage.title: Cookies and local storage
storage.body: Renown Tracker uses no advertising cookies or trackers. Your browser's local storage is only used to run the app (sign-in session, language and theme preferences, local copy of your profile), so no consent is required.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to and port your data (exporting your profile as JSON already lets you retrieve it). To exercise these rights, write to {{email}}. You can also lodge a complaint with your data protection authority (in France, the CNIL: cnil.fr).
